title: Haye sakina
body:
haye sakina shehzadi sakina
daarayn ka sultan tera baba hai sakina
shehzadi sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas sa ghazi tera saqqa hai sakina
shehzadi sakina shehzadi sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas to darya se palat kar nahi aaye
haa khoon mein dooba alam aaya hai sakina
shehzadi sakina meri shehzadi sakina
daarayn ka sultan...
<<DIVIDER>>
beti se kaha fatema zehra ke pisar ne
ta umr tujhe khaak pa sona hai sakina
shehzadi sakina meri shehzadi sakina
daarayn ka sultan...
<<DIVIDER>>
baba ko tere laa ke kafan de wo kahan se
zainab ki nigahon mein andhera hai sakina
shehzadi sakina meri shehzadi sakina
daarayn ka sultan...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai tauq e garan abid e muztar ke galay mein
honton pa magar shukr khuda ka hai sakina
shehzadi sakina meri shehzadi sakina
daarayn ka sultan...
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir ke maqsad ke liye chote se sin mein
ghazi kahin zainab kahin zehra hai sakina
shehzadi sakina meri shehzadi sakina
daarayn ka sultan...
<<DIVIDER>>
pursa tujhe is tarha diya ahle sitam ne
ab tak tere ruksaaron pa likha hai sakina
shehzadi sakina meri shehzadi sakina
daarayn ka sultan...
<<DIVIDER>>
kausar hai teri tashna dahani ke tasadduq
sharminda teri pyaas se darya hai sakina
shehzadi sakina meri shehzadi sakina
daarayn ka sultan...
<<DIVIDER>>
rauze pa tere aa ke padhe nauha ye pur gham
bas dil mein najaf ki ye tamanna hai sakina
shehzadi sakina meri shehzadi sakina
daarayn ka sultan...
author: Ali Naqvi Najaf
